title: A smooth algebra is a retract of a smooth algebra over it with a presentation of free conormal module
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $A$ a smooth $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]. Then there are a commutative $A$-algebra $C$ (an $R$-algebra via $R\to A\to C$) such that the structure map $A\to C$ is a smooth ring map [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], a homomorphism of $A$-algebras $\rho:C\to A$ (so that $\rho$ composed with the structure map $A\to C$ is $\mathrm{id}_A$), an integer $m\ge0$ and a surjective homomorphism of $R$-algebras $R[y_1,\dots,y_m]\to C$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] whose kernel $J$ has conormal module $J/J^2$ (a module over $C=R[y_1,\dots,y_m]/J$) free as a $C$-module [def-weil-pbc-free-module].

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Lemma Tag 07CE (lemma-improve-presentation, line 342), clause (1) for a = 1, and its proof (lines 357-414: C = Sym_A(I/I^2), retraction the degree-0 projection; for a = 1 the presentation C = R[x_0, x_1..x_n, y_1..y_m]/J' with J'/(J')^2 = C^{(+) m+1}). The hypothesis of clause (1), R -> A a local complete intersection (More on Algebra, Definition Tag 07D0, more-algebra-definition-local-complete-intersection), is replaced here by R -> A smooth, the only case used (Smoothing Lemma 07CG for smooth R -> A, Lemma 07CH); A is then of finite presentation, as 07CE requires. Tags 07CE and 07D0 verified in stacks-project/tags/tags.

proof.text: Choose a finite presentation $A=P/I$, $P=R[x_1,\dots,x_n]$, $I=(f_1,\dots,f_m)$: a smooth ring map is finitely presented by [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map] and [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Write $M=I/I^2$ and let $q:A^{\oplus m}\to M$ take $e_j$ to $f_j\bmod I^2$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-localization-conormal-split] with the smooth algebra $A$ and $a=1$. It gives $M\oplus\Omega_{A/R}\cong A^{\oplus n}$, so $M$ is finite projective. Because $q$ is surjective and $M$ is projective, choose an $A$-linear section $s:M\to A^{\oplus m}$; with $K=\ker q$, the maps $(k,u)\mapsto k+s(u)$ and $v\mapsto(v-s(q(v)),q(v))$ are inverse, hence $K\oplus M\cong A^{\oplus m}$.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma Tag 07CE (lemma-improve-presentation), lines 357-364 and 404-407. In the smooth case projectivity of I/I^2 also follows from the split conormal sequence, as in proof of Lemma Tag 07CH, lines 606-617.

proof.text: Set $C=\operatorname{Sym}_A(M)$ [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-universal-property]. Applying its universal property to the zero $A$-linear map $M\to A$ gives an $A$-algebra homomorphism $\rho:C\to A$; since it is an $A$-algebra homomorphism, $\rho\circ(A\to C)=\mathrm{id}_A$. As $M$ is finite projective by step 1, [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-finite-projective-smooth] says $A\to C$ is smooth. By [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-finite-presentation](a), the images of $f_1\bmod I^2,\dots,f_m\bmod I^2$ generate $C$ as an $A$-algebra; with the images of $x_1,\dots,x_n$ generating $A$ over $R$, they give a surjective $R$-algebra map $Q=R[x_1,\dots,x_n,y_1,\dots,y_m]\to C$, taking $y_j$ to the canonical image of $f_j\bmod I^2$. Put $J=\ker(Q\to C)$.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma Tag 07CE, lines 357-366 (C = Sym_A(I/I^2), degree-zero retraction, and the polynomial surjection); clause (1), lines 344-350 (C smooth over A).

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-projective-presentation-conormal] to the presentation and the finite projective module $M$ from step 1 and the map $Q\to C$ of step 2. Its hypotheses include the projectivity of $M$, which step 1 established; it gives a split exact sequence $0\to M\otimes_A C\to J/J^2\to K\otimes_A C\to0$. Thus $J/J^2\cong (M\oplus K)\otimes_A C\cong A^{\oplus m}\otimes_A C\cong C^{\oplus m}$ by the explicit decomposition of step 1, so $J/J^2$ is a free $C$-module [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Reindexing the $n+m$ variables of $Q$ as $y_1,\dots,y_{n+m}$ gives the required surjective polynomial presentation. Together with the smooth map and retraction of step 2, this proves the statement.

split_report.summary: Split the smooth case of Stacks 07CE(1) into the smooth presentation and finite-projective conormal M=I/I^2, the construction C=Sym_A(M) with retraction and smooth A-structure, and the free conormal calculation for its R-polynomial presentation. The latter is one new unsplit node with the projective hypothesis explicit: the general 07EV conormal identification is false, as the existing cotangent-complex-symmetric-algebra node records. The existing improve-presentation node proves C smooth over R and Omega free, but its statement does not give C smooth over A or a free conormal presentation, so it cannot replace this item.
